src/utils/parse-github-source.util.ts: GitHub URL detection and conversion utility. Exports `isGitHubUrl()` to check if a source string is a GitHub URL (HTTPS, SSH, or github://). Exports `toGithubUri()` to convert any GitHub URL format to the `github://` URI format used by @mcpbay/contexts-manager.
src/utils/download-github-context-conten: GitHub context content downloader utility. Uses the GitHub API to recursively download all files from a context directory. Exports `IDownloadedGitHubFile` interface and `downloadGitHubContextContent()` function that returns an array of downloaded files with path and content. Supports GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable for private repos.
src/utils/download-and-install-context-b: GitHub context installation orchestrator using @mcpbay/contexts-manager. Converts GitHub URLs to `github://` URI format, downloads context using `loadContextFromGitHub` with the package's built-in GitHub download logic, copies files to `context_modules/{name}/`, registers in the config, and injects the prompt into AGENTS.md. Exports `downloadAndInstallContextByGitHub` function.
src/commands/add.command.ts: The `add` command handler. Detects whether the source is a GitHub URL or a slug, and delegates to the appropriate download-and-install utility. After installation, checks if Deno is needed for TypeScript tools.
